description: This file defines the LinkRenderer class, which extends a base markdown link renderer to handle internal and external links appropriately, including validation, URL resolution, and attribute setting within a documentation or static site generation context.

classes.name: LinkRenderer
classes.description: A custom renderer for links in Markdown content that handles URL validation, external link styling, and internal link referencing within a documentation site.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Overrides the base render method to add logic for handling external, internal, and hash-only URLs, setting appropriate attributes on the link's HTML element.
